category_description: Standard industrial installation guidelines, maintenance procedures, troubleshooting tips, and critical safety guardrails for NIEL electrical equipment.

guides.topic: Electric Motor Mechanical Alignment and Foundation
procedure: Ensure foundation mass is at least 2.5 to 3 times the total weight of the motor to dampen mechanical vibrations.
Use dial indicators or optical laser alignment tools to check shaft alignment. Angular misalignment must be < 0.05 mm and radial parallel misalignment < 0.05 mm.
Verify axial gap in flexible couplings per manufacturer specifications to accommodate thermal shaft expansion.
Check free rotation of the motor rotor by hand prior to electrical energization to confirm no internal rubbing.
guides.safety_warning: Lockout-Tagout (LOTO) protocols must be enforced before manual rotation or coupling adjustment.

procedure: Disconnect all external cables, power factor capacitors, and electronic surge arrestors from the motor terminals.
Apply 500V DC Megger for low voltage equipment (<= 1 kV) or 1000V/2500V DC for medium voltage systems (> 1 kV).
Record IR values after 1 minute of voltage application at 40°C reference temperature.
Rule of Thumb Minimum Acceptable IR: (Rated Voltage in kV + 1) Megaohms (MΩ). If IR is < 1 MΩ, the winding must be dried out using hot air circulation or baking lamps before energizing.
guides.safety_warning: Discharge windings to earth ground immediately after Megger testing to eliminate residual capacitive charge.

procedure: Use recommended high-quality lithium-base or polyurea high-temperature industrial grease.
Do not overfill bearing housings; maintain approximately 50% to 60% void space in the housing to avoid churning and overheating.
Follow periodic re-greasing intervals (typically every 2,000 to 4,000 operating hours depending on RPM, ambient temperature, and vibration levels).
Listen for abnormal acoustic noise (grinding, whistling) or high-frequency vibration spikes indicating raceway spalling.

guides.topic: Transformer Oil Quality and Dissolved Gas Analysis (DGA)
procedure: Inspect the silica gel breather regular monthly. When silica gel crystals turn pink, replace or reactivate them by baking at 120°C until dark blue.
Test dielectric breakdown voltage (BDV) of transformer mineral oil: new oil BDV >= 40 kV; in-service oil must be filtered if BDV falls below 30 kV.

Inspect Buchholz relay gas collection chamber. If gas accumulates, analyze gas color: white gas indicates paper insulation breakdown; yellow/grey indicates arcing; dark black indicates heavy flashover.
guides.safety_warning: Never sample transformer oil or inspect Buchholz relays on energized high-voltage transformers without safety clearance.

guides.topic: Medium Voltage Switchgear Mechanical and Electrical Interlocks
procedure: Circuit breaker cannot be racked in or out when the vacuum breaker is in the CLOSED position.
Circuit breaker cannot be closed unless it is fully locked in the TEST or SERVICE position.
Earth switch cannot be closed when the circuit breaker is racked into the SERVICE position.
Compartment access doors cannot be opened unless the line earth switch is fully engaged.
guides.safety_warning: CRITICAL ELECTRICAL SAFETY ADVISORY: Never force or bypass mechanical door interlocks on medium-voltage switchgear. Arc flash hazard can result in fatal burns. De-energize upstream busbars and verify zero voltage with an approved capacitive detector before opening compartments.
